name: trippy
description: Modern network diagnostic tool with interactive TUI interface, supporting multiple protocols, GeoIP lookup, and comprehensive tracing capabilities

trippy.description: Advanced network diagnostic tool with TUI, supporting ICMP/UDP/TCP tracing, GeoIP, AS information, and multiple output formats
trippy.usage:
trippy google.com # Interactive TUI trace
trippy --mode stream google.com # Stream output
trippy --protocol udp --target-port 53 8.8.8.8 # UDP trace
trippy --ipv6 ipv6.google.com # IPv6 trace
trippy --mode json google.com # JSON output
